_note: Escape endings. Every clip starts on images/hallway.jpg and is pinned to a generated destination plate as image_end, exactly like the monster event clips. The room-transition `common` in regen_config.json cannot be reused here: it says 'preserve exact architecture, empty environment', which fights a clip whose whole job is to leave the building.
_common_note: Two separate strings on purpose. The first attempt used one shared `common` carrying 'walk through an open doorway', which Flux painted INTO the destination plate — every ending arrived at a view framed by a doorframe, so the clip stopped on the threshold instead of walking out. The still must describe only where you end up; the doorway belongs to the video alone.
stillCommon: realistic cinematic landscape photograph, vertical mobile portrait framing, warm natural daylight, calm peaceful hopeful, wide open outdoor view filling the entire frame edge to edge, standing outside in the open air, no doorway, no door frame, no window, no window frame, no interior, no walls, no people, no readable text, no watermark

endings.title: The Gate Was Open
endings.still: wide open gravel drive leading away from an old country house at sunrise, tall iron gate standing open at the far end, soft pink and gold dawn sky over flat green fields, long dewy shadows, calm empty peaceful morning, no people
endings.video: the camera walks down the dim central hallway to the heavy front door, the door swings open and floods the hallway with pink-gold sunrise light, the camera walks out across the front step and down the gravel drive toward the open iron gate and the bright open fields beyond

endings.title: Grass To The Horizon
endings.still: sunlit summer wildflower meadow stretching to a distant treeline, tall grass and white and yellow flowers, warm high morning sun, soft blue sky with a few clouds, calm empty peaceful, no people
endings.video: the camera walks down the dim central hallway to the door at the end, the door opens onto blinding warm summer daylight, the camera walks out of the house and into a sunlit wildflower meadow, tall grass brushing past the lens, the house left behind

endings.title: The Long Way Home

endings.video: the camera walks down the dim central hallway to the front door, the door opens onto low warm orange sunset light, the camera walks out of the house and away down a quiet country lane between tall hedgerows, the golden evening light growing warmer

endings.title: Still Water

endings.title: The Walled Garden
